summary: Car ignition RLC circuit: after switching at t=0, find initial conditions of capacitor voltage/current, derive and solve the second-order (underdamped LC with R) differential equation for Vc(t), find conditions for |Vc|≥3000V, sketch Vc(t) for R=1Ω, L=1H, C=16µF, time of first maximum, and energy-based condition for |Vc|≥300V.
